critical_code_review_comments: Warnings only (non-blocking): passlib using deprecated `crypt` module (Python 3.13 removal), python_multipart pending deprecation, emergentintegrations Stripe SDK still using Pydantic V1 `@validator` decorators (V3 migration needed eventually). None affect functionality.

Test file uses `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(...)` via `run()` helper plus per-test `event_loop` fixture — works reliably here but `asyncio.get_event_loop()` is deprecated in 3.12+. Future-proof: switch to `asyncio.new_event_loop()` directly inside `run()` or use `pytest-asyncio`.
Test data cleanup uses regex match on refund.reason field — correct given the ACID guard message embeds reta_id. Confirmed: no leakage across runs.
seed_data_creation: Per-test fixtures create disposable retas (`iter46-acid-test-<uuid>`), inscripciones, mp_transactions, stripe_transactions and audit rows; all deleted by teardown. No persistent seed data added.
